notes: Original primary title and DOI verified in supplied canonical text. Rendered supplied PDF pages 6, 10 and 11 (printed pp. 163, 167–168). Final sample is explicitly 113 participants: 56 exposure and 57 checking. Exclusions: 10 incomplete Memory Questionnaires (5 each condition), 1 incomplete Stovetop Task (exposure), 3 incomplete STAI (2 checking, 1 exposure). Candidate arithmetic only: 56 + 57 = 113; recruitment accounting 127 - 10 - 1 - 3 = 113. No N inferred from degrees of freedom. Because row-specific test correspondence remains unresolved, common sample N is retained only as a candidate for parent field-scope review. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. PDF page 10 / printed p.167 Table 1 t candidates: age 0.09, OCI-R 1.48, OCI-R-Ch 0.76, STAIT 3.38, STAIS 2.67; table star means p<.05 for STAIT and STAIS. Text p.166 gives same-test STAI-S t(111)=2.67,p=.01 and STAI-T t(111)=3.38,p=.001. Accuracy F candidates on p.167: time F(1,108)=8.69,p=.004,partial eta-squared=.074; stimulus-by-time F(1,108)=25.34,p<.001,partial eta-squared=.19; time-by-condition F(1,108)=0.02,p=.89. Confidence stimulus main effect F(1,108)=42.55,p<.001,partial eta-squared=.28 spans pp.167–168. The tenth article page (p.168) additionally has confidence/vividness/detail interactions F=109.15/63.64/98.26, all p<.001, and confidence three-way F=5.31,p=.023,partial eta-squared=.05.
